scenes.vo: Your best YouTube video might be one almost nobody saw.

scenes.title: Views × engagement
scenes.vo: Here's how to find it. Put every video on a chart. Views per day this way, likes, comments and shares per view that way. You get four groups.

scenes.meaning: Loved, but hardly anyone finds it.
scenes.vo: Top left are your hidden gems. The people who find them love them, so the video's fine. It's the packaging. Try a new title, with the words people actually type into search. Or a thumbnail you can read at phone size. Then wait.

scenes.title: One change. Two weeks.
scenes.subtitle: Swap the title and thumbnail on the same day and you'll never know which one worked.
scenes.vo: One change at a time, and give it two weeks. Swap the title and the thumbnail on the same day and you'll never know which one did it.
If you'd rather not do this by hand, Backsurge draws the map for you, and tracks the change.
Two weeks later, you know if it worked.

scenes.headline: Next: the opposite problem.
scenes.vo: Next one's the opposite problem. Follow so you don't miss it.
